searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he bounded search harness delta the awtsmoos gives request shape, transport, and activity their separate vessels of light; awtsmoos.com tests each owner where it lives instead of flattening browser modules into a data url night. evidence searchapi.js is a 47 line browser composition module. it imports browser root /shared/meaningfulactivity.js, relative apitransport.js, and relative searchlibraryrequest.js. the old test base64 imports searchapi.js as a data: url; node cannot resolve browser root or relative module imports from that non hierarchical base. searchlibraryrequest.js owns the library query url and parameters: q, optional lane, default limit=20, autoinstall=false, strategy, and optional semantic requireindexed=true. it does not add a comments parameter. apitransport.js owns credentials: 'same origin', json parsing, timeout/abort behavior, and api/network errors. searchapi.js composes buildlibrarysearchrequest() then requestjson() and records successful search activity afterward. delta searchapiboundedcomments.test.mjs uses an obsolete data url module harness that cannot represent the current browser module graph. exact rewrite rewrite only searchapiboundedcomments.test.mjs completely: directly exercise buildlibrarysearchrequest() and verify bounded query parameters with no comments parameter; directly exercise requestjson() with a mocked fetch and verify credentials: 'same origin' plus json return; statically verify searchapi.js imports and composes the builder and transport; keep the test <=120 lines; do not remove activity telemetry or rewrite production just to satisfy a node only harness. next action rewrite the harness, reread it, run it directly, then rerun the complete sefarim suite fail fast.
